title: Soybean okara: a sustainable and cost-effective alternative for potato dextrose agar and nutrient agar media
author: Maheshwari, Kumar, et al.

steps.title: Prepare Nystatin Stock Solution
steps.instruction: Dissolve 500 mg Nystatin powder in 9 mL DMSO in a 15 mL Eppendorf tube, shake to mix, adjust volume to 10 mL with DMSO (final concentration 50 mg mL⁻¹), filter‑sterilize through a 0.22 µm bacteriological filter, aliquot into a sterile 15 mL tube, wrap in aluminium foil, store at –20 °C, and later add to media at 50 µg mL⁻¹.

steps.title: Prepare Chloramphenicol Stock Solution
steps.instruction: Dissolve 300 mg chloramphenicol powder in 9 mL 70 % ethanol in a 15 mL Eppendorf tube, mix until fully dissolved, bring volume to 10 mL with 70 % ethanol (final concentration 30 mg mL⁻¹), filter‑sterilize through a 0.22 µm filter, transfer to a sterile 15 mL tube, wrap in aluminium foil, store at –20 °C, and later add to OF agar at 170 µg mL⁻¹.

steps.title: Dry and Grind Soybean Okara
steps.instruction: Collect okara from tofu production, dry in an oven at 65 °C for 24 h, then grind to a fine powder using a mixer‑grinder.

steps.title: Make Okara Fungal Broth (OF)
steps.instruction: Weigh 10 g dried okara powder, add to 950 mL double‑distilled water in a beaker, microwave at 100 °C for 2 min, strain through muslin cloth, add 20 g dextrose, adjust pH to 5.6 at 25 °C, and bring final volume to 1000 mL with distilled water.

steps.title: Prepare Okara Fungal Agar Medium
steps.instruction: Take the OF broth prepared above, add 16 g agar‑agar after pH adjustment, bring volume to 1000 mL with distilled water, autoclave at 121 °C for 20 min, cool to 42–44 °C, then add chloramphenicol from stock to a final concentration of 170 µg mL⁻¹.

steps.title: Make Okara Bacterial Broth (OB)
steps.instruction: Weigh 10 g okara powder and 5 g NaCl, add to 950 mL double‑distilled water, microwave at 100 °C for 2 min, strain through muslin cloth, add 10 g dextrose, adjust pH to 7.6 at 25 °C, and bring final volume to 1000 mL with distilled water.

steps.title: Prepare Okara Bacterial Agar Medium
steps.instruction: To the OB broth, add 16 g agar‑agar after pH adjustment, bring volume to 1000 mL with distilled water, autoclave at 121 °C for 20 min, cool to 42–44 °C, then add nystatin from stock to a final concentration of 50 µg mL⁻¹.

steps.title: Grow Fungal Inoculum on PDA
steps.instruction: Inoculate Rhizoctonia solani, Sclerotium rolfsii, and Colletotrichum truncatum onto potato dextrose agar plates, incubate at 28 ± 2 °C for 5 days to obtain fresh 5‑day‑old cultures for experiments.

steps.title: Measure Fungal Colony Diameter
steps.instruction: Using a cork borer, cut 10 mm diameter discs from the 5‑day‑old fungal cultures, place each disc centrally on OF agar plates (and PDA as control), incubate at 28 ± 2 °C in a BOD incubator, and record colony diameters when the plate is completely covered; perform 8 replicates in a completely randomized design.

steps.title: Determine Fungal Dry Biomass
steps.instruction: Autoclave 250 mL conical flasks containing 100 mL OF broth, inoculate each with a 10 mm fungal disc (and parallel flasks with PDB as control), incubate at 28 ± 2 °C, 80 rpm shaking for 5 days (8 replicates), decant broth, oven‑dry mycelium at 80 °C for 48 h, and weigh to obtain dry biomass.

steps.title: Prepare Bacterial Inoculum in Nutrient Broth
steps.instruction: Grow Bacillus amyloliquefaciens, Achromobacter denitrificans, and Pseudomonas sp. in nutrient broth at 28 °C for 24 h, measure OD₆₀₀, and dilute with sterile uninoculated nutrient broth to an optical density of 1.00.

steps.title: Streak Bacterial Colonies on Agar
steps.instruction: Streak one loopful of each bacterial culture onto OB agar plates and onto nutrient agar (NA) plates (controls), prepare 8 replicates, incubate at 28 °C for 24 h, using both 0.5 % and 1 % dextrose OB agar formulations to observe colony characteristics.

steps.title: Measure Bacterial Growth in Broth
steps.instruction: In sterile 30 mL test tubes containing 10 mL OB broth with 1 % dextrose, inoculate 10 µL of the adjusted bacterial suspension, prepare 8 replicates, incubate at 28 °C, 120 rpm shaking, and record OD₆₀₀ after 24 h.

steps.title: Isolate Rhizospheric Bacteria and Fungi
steps.instruction: Weigh 1 g rhizospheric soil from soybean or wheat, serially dilute to 10⁻⁶, spread 100 µL onto OB agar and NA for bacteria; from a 10⁻⁴ dilution, spread 100 µL onto OF agar and PDA for fungi; prepare 8 replicates, incubate at 28 °C for 48 h, then count colonies.

steps.title: Isolate Endophytic Bacteria and Fungi
steps.instruction: Uproot soybean or wheat roots, wash, surface‑sterilize in 2 % NaOCl for 2 min, rinse twice with sterile water, immerse in 70 % ethanol for 2 min, rinse ten times with sterile water, crush with mortar and pestle, serially dilute, spread 100 µL of the 10⁻⁶ dilution onto OB agar and NA for bacteria and 100 µL of the 10⁻⁴ dilution onto OF agar and PDA for fungi; prepare 8 replicates, incubate at 28 °C for 48 h, then count colonies.

steps.title: Calculate Colony Forming Units (CFU)
steps.instruction: Compute CFU mL⁻¹ using the formula: CFU mL⁻¹ = (number of colonies × dilution factor) ÷ 0.1 mL (volume spread).

description: Where transparent Petri dishes are PDA and translucent plates are OF agar media.
